correctness.rationale: The Prue–Scrimshaw hypotheses hold for two points on the 4-regular graph with girth 3. Exact 2D unordered cubical model has 36 vertices, 126 edges, 99 squares. Its integer boundary has Smith factors 1^80, 2, hence rank 81 and top integral homology Z^18. All 18 triangle-square torus chains have zero boundary and their 99x18 Smith form is 1^16,2,2, with a maximal minor -4. An 18x18 determinant +1 minor among the 24 triangle-square/triangle-triangle chains, and a separate 20-column Smith check for one row-pair plus one column-pair, establish primitive spanning. The exact package verifier reproduces every claim.

value.rationale: The nine-vertex rook graph is the small natural Hamming/Paley model with full (S3×S3)⋊C2 symmetry. Its entire 18-element symmetry orbit of vertex-disjoint triangle-square tori is rationally complete but integrally deficient by two independent parity classes; explicit shorter triangle-pair tori resolve the defect. This gives a motivated exact natural integral generator-lattice invariant, not a routine Betti-number recount, and distinguishes rational spanning from integral generating for a concrete canonical configuration space.
